result.summary: Introduces a new "mining" logging category and moves the CreateNewBlock() log line behind it. This stops the block template generation line from logging unconditionally, requiring -debug=mining to be enabled instead.
result.problem: CreateNewBlock() logs block weight messages unconditionally whenever a block template is generated. Services that frequently trigger block template creation, such as Electrum server implementations, spam debug.log with entries that node operators cannot disable.
evidence: Fixes linked issue #36334 ('log: frequent CreateNewBlock() log lines on 32.x with electrum server'), where users reported debug log bloat.
result.scope_notes: Small patch adding a new debug category to logging flags and gating a single log call.
result.card: Introduces a new mining logging category (-debug=mining) and moves the CreateNewBlock() block weight log line behind it. Previously, the message was logged unconditionally, flooding debug.log when services like Electrum servers polled block templates frequently. Issue #36334 reported the spam filling up log files with no way for node operators to turn it off.

risk.why: Touches only logging category definitions and a debug log statement; a bug would only affect log output visibility.
